# Antigravity Tutor Plugin

A plugin that adds a dedicated `/tutor` skill to your Antigravity CLI. When invoked, it forces the agent to explain computer science concepts, architectures, frameworks, or algorithms using a structured framework emphasizing production practicality.

## Installation

You can install this plugin directly from GitHub using the Antigravity CLI:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/lolvansh/antigravity-tutor-plugin
```

## Usage

Simply invoke the skill in your chat:

```text
/tutor Explain how WebSockets work
```

The agent will break down the concept using the following framework:
1. The Core Concept (Mental Model)
2. Where It Rules (Primary Use Cases)
3. Where It Fails (Anti-Patterns)
4. Quick Code/Architecture Sample

It will automatically revert to a normal coding assistant in subsequent messages.
